decisions.reason: The accelerator is peripheral to the machinery core and has no visible market traction beyond its 2023 home-page mention, but running it costs little and its partnership value is still unresolved, so it stays open while remaining at high risk of being cut.

The CO2-negative bio-bitumen is a flagship with large but slow-to-resolve upside in construction materials, and two years is too short to show its value is unlikely, so keeping this low-cost option is justified.
The infectious waste plant builds on the core modular WASTX platform and the ERMAFA partnership, so it is cheap to maintain and its prospects are still developing, which favors keeping it.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the decentralized recycling strategy and existing manufacturing know-how, and it also serves as a pretreatment stage for other systems, so it is a low-cost option worth keeping.
